about: Curated per-step labels for scoring the agent, derived from each clip's published LSV error text. trueSkips: steps the operator omitted. errorSteps: steps with a non-skip deviation (a contradiction there counts as a detection). eitherSteps: a skip or a contradiction both count. Any other skipped/out-of-order/contradicted verdict is a false alarm. split: dev clips may be inspected and tuned on; held-out clips are run once after the design lock.

DJI_16.note: Reagent 2 added to reagent 3 instead of the mixing tube. 25 s excerpt: steps 1, 4, 5, 7 are outside the footage, not omitted.

DJI_08.note: Published error (no incubation after TrypLE) has no step in this clip's protocol, so it cannot be scored per step.
